headline: Fitch puts global sovereign rating outlook at "neutral"; sees risks from debt, war and AI
summary: Fitch set its outlook for global sovereign ratings to neutral for the coming year. It said steady economic growth will offset higher financing costs, while flagging debt, war and AI risks.
why: Fitch is one of the three major credit rating agencies, and its sovereign outlooks inform borrowing costs and investor assessments of government debt.
original_headline: Fitch pone perspectiva "neutral" a la calificación soberana mundial; ve riesgos de deuda, guerra e IA
